newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea seen seeking 50,000T feed wheat next week.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea seen seeking 50,000T feed wheat next week.

text.p: At least one South Korean grain buyer is expected to seek one 50,000-tonne cargo of feed wheat next week, traders said on Friday.
Korea Feed Association (KFA) was suspected of requiring one 50,000-tonne cargo of feed wheat for arrival for January 30 to the port cities of Inchon and Ulsan. But KFA denied the talk.
Traders said National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) was still believed to be seeking 52,500 tonnes of feed wheat or corn. However, NLCF said they have no plans to tender next week.
NLCF had passed on tenders for 52,500 tonnes of feed wheat on November 13 due to higher offered prices than expected, they said.
Shipment of the NLCF's tender had been set for January 25-February 13 if sourced from Canada, Australia and the Pacific Northwest or for January 6-25 if sourced from Europe and the U.S. Gulf.
